method: All six printed pages read from the supplied Part 1 PDF at 3x zoom (whole-page renders plus glyph-level checks of every number and ambiguous token), with explicit local traversals recorded per page. Ordered source blocks include every instructional bullet, table row/cell, flowchart step, diagram label, arrow annotation, legend entry and caption. Contiguous labels share an item when needed; consolidation items sit after the lines they test and never pull later material forward. Headers, timestamps, footers and blank Active space excluded.
caveats: p735: creatinine is printed as '113 Kda molecule' where standard molecular weight is 113 Da (not kDa). Value is taught as printed and flagged as a unit error; cystatin C correctly prints as 13 KDa on p737.

p736: the dependent-on list prints 'Race (↓ in African Americans)' and 'Sex (↓ in males)' – the downward arrows are the printed wording taught verbatim, even though greater muscle mass typically makes creatinine higher in these groups. The page also prints '↓ Protein supplementation → ↓ muscle mass → ↓ S.Cr' which is taught as printed.

p736 graph: plasma creatinine axis is labelled 'Plasma creatinine (mg/dL)' and GFR axis 'GFR (mL/min)' with a marked point at S.Cr 2 and GFR 60; the worked examples '5→20 insignificant (already ESRD)' and '1.7→2.8: 50→30' are taught as printed.

p738: RPF is printed as '700 ml' without '/min' in the FF denominator; taught as printed (standard RPF ~600-700 ml/min). The autoregulation graph x-axis 'Mean arterial blood pressure (mm Hg)' 0-240 and y-axis 'Flow rate (L/min)' 0-1.5 are taught via explicit axis questions.

p739: the arteriolar table prints 'unfavourable' for increased afferent and decreased efferent rows, and 'Favourable for kidney' for decreased afferent; increased efferent has no favourability label – taught as printed. The NSAID chain includes 'maintain GFR ← ↓ GFR & ↓ RBF' with a left-pointing arrow, taught as printed.
